description: Get seller billing activities (fees and credits) from the eBay Finances API. eBay requires exactly one filter criterion: activityId, listingId, orderId, or a transactionDate range starting within the last 120 days. Page with limit/offset, sort by transactionDate. Requires the sell.finances scope. eBay requires Digital Signatures on Finances API calls for EU/UK sellers; set EBAY_SIGNING_KEY_JWE and EBAY_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY to sign them.

acceptLanguage.description: Overrides the Accept-Language header for the response locale, e.g. en-US or de-DE. Defaults to EBAY_CONTENT_LANGUAGE; eBay assumes en-US when the header is absent.

filter.description: eBay requires exactly one criterion: activityId:{12**56} (a billingTransactionId), listingId:{...}, orderId:{...}, or transactionDate:[2025-10-01T00:00:00Z..2025-10-31T23:59:59Z] in UTC with a start no more than 120 days ago.

limit.description: Records per page, up to 200 (eBay default 100)

offset.description: Zero-based number of records to skip before the page starts (eBay default 0)

sort.description: Set to transactionDate for oldest first; activities sort only by date. eBay sorts newest first by default.

name: ebay_get_billing_activities
